task: Plane-geometry validation (has_standard_plane_sizes) reached via public decode of an uncompressed image carrying filter_array/depth/disparity (extra) data channels; feature adds expected-size rules for those channels and rejects heif_channel_unknown rather than guessing. Single lib file libheif/image/pixelimage.cc (+7/-0). Injected-defect guess CWE-787 (wrong expected size lets a malformed plane bypass the gate -> downstream OOB write).
